topic: The Ketchup Packet That Picked Its Target
background: Simple kitchen with a table, burger, ketchup packet, and one chair.
scene_1: K-Stick places a burger on the table and carefully tears open a ketchup packet.
scene_2: He squeezes the packet with both hands, but the ketchup shoots backward onto his white face.
scene_3: K-Stick calmly lifts the burger for a bite while ketchup drips from his face like a bright red moustache.
twist_ending: The burger has no ketchup at all, while K-Stick accidentally wears the entire serving on his face.
narration: K-Stick carefully opens the ketchup packet. One squeeze later, his burger stays dry—but his face gets a very delicious makeover.
video_title: K-Stick and the Ketchup Packet That Picked Its Target
facebook_caption: K-Stick wanted ketchup on his burger. The ketchup had other plans.
youtube_description: K-Stick tries to add ketchup to his burger, but the packet fires backward and gives him a surprise moustache instead!
